name: Claude Code Persistence
description: Persists the Claude Code login and conversation history across container rebuilds via a shared Docker volume.
postStartCommand: [ -w "/mnt/claude-code-config" ] || sudo -n chown -R "$(id -u):$(id -g)" "/mnt/claude-code-config" || echo "claude-persist: '/mnt/claude-code-config' is not writable and passwordless sudo is unavailable" >&2
